answer.reason: In the EIA California Electricity Profile, Table 1 (summary statistics for the total electric power industry) breaks net generation out by sector. California's electric utility sector contributes a relatively small share of in-state generation (roughly 40%), with independent power producers supplying the bulk. The figure of approximately 75.9 million MWh corresponds to the Electric utilities row, whereas 138 million MWh is too high for utilities alone and is more consistent with the IPP/CHP category.
